title: Netflix Tests $66 Support Ahead of October Earnings
summary: Netflix reports earnings on October 20th after a punishing 15 months. The stock has fallen nearly 50% from its 2025 highs and recently traded as low as $66 a share, where buyers have repeatedly stepped in to defend the level.
